services.name: Snorkel trip
services.desc: Experience Waikiki’s incredible aquatic life with us located on Oahu’s south shore right in front of the Waikiki Skyline. Guests will have the opportunity to snorkel with Hawaii Green Sea turtles, and numerous species of reef fish, and every now and then we get surrounded by dolphins or a Humpback Whale breaching in the distance during Whale Season. The scheduled guests should arrive at the ‘Kewalo Basin Harbor’ Address Search: 1125 Ala Moana Blvd., Honolulu, Hawaii 96814 (Pier B-6) at least 15 minutes prior to the ship’s departure. services.name: Private Surf Lesson
services.desc: Experience the thrill of surfing in Waikiki’s iconic waters with a private lesson tailored just for you-or share the adventure with friends and family. Perfect for all group sizes and skill levels, our private sessions offer personalized instruction from expert instructors who adapt to each person’s comfort, athletic ability, and prior experience. Your lesson begins with a friendly and informative safety briefing on the beach, covering the fundamentals-paddling techniques, standing up on the board, and confidently riding your first wave. services.desc: Choose Go Tours Hawaii for all your charter bus and transportation needs on Oahu and Maui. Relax in our modern mini-coaches, designed to provide the utmost comfort. Our friendly and knowledgeable charter team specializes in crafting personalized charters and itineraries. We collaborate closely with you and your group to design the perfect travel experience. Whether you’re heading from Honolulu to the North Shore or exploring any spot in between, trust us to handle the driving and ensure your trip is wonderful from beginning to end!
